preconditions.description: Must be contract owner to call includeInReward()
At least two addresses must be in the _excluded array
Target address to include must be in the _excluded array

exploit_hint: As owner, call includeInReward() on an address that is not the last element in the _excluded array. This will corrupt the _excludedAddressToId mapping for the address that gets moved to the removed position, making its index mapping point to 0 while it remains in the array. This breaks the consistency between the array and mapping, potentially causing issues in _getCurrentSupply() calculations and reward distribution.
